title: Rav Sima son of Rav Idi
author: Aharon Hyman

paragraphs: He is mentioned in [Menachot 25a](https://www.sefaria.org/Menachot.25a.9), raising an objection to Rav Ashi.[^1]

notes.text: The linked Menachot names Rav Sima son of Rav Idi, or, in another version, Rav Sima son of Rav Ashi. In both versions he directs his objection to Rav Ashi.
